 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background, line_color = counts.most_common(2)[0][0], counts.most_common(2)[1][0]

    # The colored lattice is drawn with a frequent line color over the background.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line_color for v in grid[r]) >= 0.65 * w]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= 0.65 * h]

    # Ignore continuation/padding lines that have no marked intersections.
    cols = [c for c in cols if any(grid[r][c] not in (background, line_color) for r in rows)]
    rows = [r for r in rows if any(grid[r][c] not in (background, line_color) for c in cols)]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        result_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]]

        out.append(result_row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    # Grid of colored lines around uniform rectangular cells. Extract the color at
    # line intersections, then return the bounded cell-pattern of those markers.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg, line = counts.most_common(2)[0][0], counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line for v in grid[r]) >= 0.65 * w]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) >= 0.65 * h]
    cols = [c for c in cols if any(grid[r][c] not in (bg, line) for r in rows)]
    rows = [r for r in rows if any(grid[r][c] not in (bg, line) for c in cols)]
    out = []

        row = []
